label: Run FreeFEM
args: NBPROC=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*//.*NBPROC' "$ZED_FILE" | sed -E 's/.*NBPROC[[:space:]]*([0-9]+).*/\1/' | head -n 1); PARAM=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*//.*PARAM' "$ZED_FILE" | sed -E 's/.*PARAM[[:space:]]*(.*)/\1/' | head -n 1); cd "$(dirname "$ZED_FILE")" && if [ -z "$NBPROC" ] || [ "$NBPROC" = "1" ]; then FreeFem++ "$ZED_FILENAME" -cd $PARAM; else ff-mpirun -np $NBPROC "$ZED_FILENAME" -cd $PARAM; fi
